title: 第一章 黑水夜诡第二章 技艺圆满
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
夜，乌云坨坨。
秋月被遮，偶尔挣扎着漏下几缕惨白的光，照得河面泛起冰冷的波光。
冷风掠过黑水河，卷起大片芦苇荡，发出“沙沙”的声音。
黑暗深处，不时传来“咯吱…咯吱…”的声响，像是某种东西在用力的磨着牙。
不远处，苏羽坐在一块湿滑的青石上，脑袋一点一点地打着盹。
睡梦中，身后飘忽的声音钻入耳中。
“苏羽，来鱼了，起网！”
“快起网！”
苏羽迷迷糊糊醒了过来，眼前是墨汁般死寂的河面，伸手不见五指。
来鱼了？
念头刚起，水中便传来“噗通”的巨响，激起大片水花。看来，刺网真挂住了大家伙。
尽管睡意未消，但身体的本能让他立刻攥紧了手中的鱼绳，奋力向后拉扯。
但是试了几下，刺网却没有被拉动。绳索的另一头，传来一股死沉的巨力，仿佛挂住的不是鱼，而是一块水底的礁石。
这是抓到大鱼了？
他揉了揉眼角，睁大眼睛，看不透那黑漆漆的水面下到底有啥。
将鱼绳往手指上缠了两圈，再次用力，手指被勒的已经隐隐发白，那刺网还是没有拉回一寸。
这么大的鱼？
不对劲！
苏羽脑中疑惑骤升，看这力道更像是真的挂底了！
但是黑水河水深足有上百丈，自己这刺网不过半丈，怎么可能挂底？

正当他惊疑不定时，身后声音再次提醒。
“是宝鱼，快下水！”
“快下水！要跑了……”
宝鱼？
这两个字像一团火，瞬间点燃了苏羽的心。一条宝鱼，至少值数十两银子，可不能让它跑了。
他下意识地抓着绳索，一步步走向河边。
一阵夜风吹过，芦苇荡发出沙沙的声音，好似在欢喜着什么。
眼看一只脚就要踏入冰冷的河水，苏羽的脑海中突然想到了什么。
等等……今晚，不是只有我一个人来捕鱼吗？
“唰！”一股寒气从尾椎骨直冲天灵盖，苏羽全身的汗毛瞬间倒竖，整个人僵在了原地。
那刚才……在我身后说话的，是谁？
咚！咚！咚！
他的心脏疯狂跳动，仿佛要从胸膛里跳出来。
随着他停下脚步，身后的黑暗中，一股刺骨的寒意如有实质般贴了上来，滑腻冰冷，宛如一条毒蛇正缓缓游过他的后背。
碰上……脏东西了？
苏羽狠狠咬破嘴唇，剧痛让他混乱的大脑恢复了一丝清明。
content_en:
At night, there are dark clouds.
The autumn moon was obscured, and occasionally struggled to leak out a few rays of pale light, illuminating the river with cold ripples.
The cold wind swept across the Heishui River, rolling up large swaths of reeds and making a "rustling" sound.
Deep in the darkness, there were "creak...creak..." sounds from time to time, as if something was grinding its teeth hard.
Not far away, Su Yu was sitting on a piece of slippery bluestone, nodding off little by little.
In his sleep, an erratic voice behind him penetrated his ears.
"Su Yu, the fish are coming, set up the net!"
"Get up the net quickly!"
Su Yu woke up in a daze. In front of him was the ink-like dead river surface, and he couldn't see his fingers.
Fish coming?
As soon as the thought came up, there was a loud "plop" sound in the water, causing large splashes of water. It seems that the gill net really caught the big guy.
Although he was still sleepy, his body's instinct made him immediately tighten his grip on the fishing rope and pull back with all his strength.
But after several attempts, the gill net was not pulled. From the other end of the rope, there was a huge force, as if what was caught was not a fish, but an underwater reef.
Did you catch a big fish?
He rubbed the corners of his eyes and opened them wide, unable to see what was under the dark water.
He wrapped the fishing rope around his fingers twice and applied force again. His fingers were already pale from being strangled, but the gill net still hadn't been pulled back an inch.
Such a big fish?
Something's wrong!
Doubts suddenly rose in Su Yu's mind, and it looked like he was really losing his strength!
But the Heishui River is hundreds of feet deep, and my gill net is only half a foot deep. How could it catch the bottom?
Just when he was in doubt, the voice behind him reminded him again.
"It's Baoyu, get in the water quickly!"
"Hurry into the water! I'm going to run away..."
Baoyu?
These two words were like a ball of fire, instantly igniting Su Yu's heart. A treasure fish is worth at least dozens of taels of silver, so you can't let it run away.
He subconsciously grabbed the rope and walked towards the river step by step.
A gust of night wind blew by, and the reeds made a rustling sound, as if they were rejoicing.
Seeing that one foot was about to step into the cold river water, Su Yu suddenly thought of something in his mind.
Wait...am I not the only one fishing tonight?
"Whoa!" A gust of cold air rushed from the tailbone to the sky. The hair on Su Yu's body stood on end instantly, and he froze in place.
Then...who was speaking behind me just now?
Boom! Boom! Boom!
His heart was beating wildly, as if it was about to burst out of his chest.
As he stopped, in the darkness behind him, a biting coldness seemed to stick to him. It was smooth and cold, like a poisonous snake slowly swimming across his back.
Encountered...dirty stuff?
Su Yu bit his lip hard, and the severe pain restored some clarity to his chaotic brain.
